items.name: CUSTOM FINANCIAL ANALYSIS SOLUTION
items.description: Software Solution to simply output financial analysis reports with custom functions to compare together periods of financial spending.
items.detail: Used to make financial decisions and provide clarity based on transaction data in csv files.

items.name: ULTIMATE SHOPPING
items.description: Automated scripting that pulls information from the Flipp application, via the weekly retail fliers, and stores the deals into a CSV.
items.detail: AI is a great tool to analyze information, thus we can find killer deals that are in the brochures this week.

items.name: FINANCIAL DATA PIPELINE
items.description: A fault-tolerant ETL pipeline that processes millions of financial transactions daily with 99.99% reliability and end-to-end encryption.
items.detail: Replaced fragile cron-based jobs with an event-driven architecture featuring automatic retries, dead-letter queues, and data lineage tracking. Reduced manual intervention from 8+ hours per week to near-zero.

items.name: STM INTERACTIVE MAP
items.description: An interactive transit map for exploring Montreal's STM routes and discovering how to connect across the city.
items.detail: Built a small web application with HTML, CSS, and Python, using maps and shapes from the STM website to make the city's transit network easier to explore and understand.

items.name: STREAMLINED CONTENT UPLOADER
items.description: Social media outlets provide API Endpoints to push content (except Tiktok) and we can leverage these to streamline content creation.
items.detail: Scripting that pushes a video, with the option of content modification to have unique fingerprint, to all platforms. For Tiktok, a selenium instance is initiated to upload the video manually.

steps.title: START WITH THE BUSINESS PROBLEM
steps.description: I never reach for a technology before understanding the actual need. The best architecture solves the right problem.

steps.title: DESIGN FOR EVOLUTION
steps.description: Software that can't change is software that fails. I build for flexibility, making the hard parts replaceable.

steps.title: SIMPLIFY RELENTLESSLY
steps.description: Every line of code is a liability. I remove unnecessary dependencies, abstractions, and complexity at every step.

steps.title: BUILD RELIABILITY IN, NOT ON
steps.description: I treat observability, testing, and failure recovery as first-class features, not afterthoughts.

about.title: 04 — ABOUT
about.heading: BUILDING SYSTEMS
bio: I started out in school as a chemical engineer, and eventually got into data. I learned that systems are only as good as their operators—and that reliability is a design choice, not a side effect.

I transitioned to software engineering in 2019, drawn by the challenge of building systems at scale. Today, I work at the intersection of data, backend, and cloud infrastructure—designing platforms that make data accessible, trustworthy, and impactful.
I believe the best engineers don't just write code; they understand the business context, simplify the problem, and build solutions that outlast their own tenure.
